title: Add Briefly to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Briefly](https://briefly-app.defyma.com) to chat
- Briefly turns rough notes into structured output, breaks big goals into actionable steps, and drafts clear replies in a focused chat thread.

Fixes #11282

gist.headline: Notes, meet your tiny ladder
gist.blurb: Briefly has joined the chat. Drop in a pile of rough notes and it helps turn them into steps, structure, and replies that sound like you had a plan all along.
gist.summary: Added Briefly to the app catalog and chat, where it turns rough notes into structured output, breaks large goals into actionable steps, and drafts focused replies.
gist.impact: People can now find and use Briefly through pollinations chat when they need to turn an idea pile into a clearer plan or response.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Briefly as a cozy focused chat workspace: scattered sticky-note ideas becoming a neat staircase of small task cards beside a retro terminal. Polli should wear a tiny librarian visor and gently carry a note toward the organized plan, with code-plants and flowers growing from the completed steps to show ideas becoming useful action.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and rounded light blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny librarian visor as she carries a rough sticky note into a retro chat terminal where messy notes transform into a neat staircase of task cards and blooming code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, subtle CRT glow, pixel-font text: “BRIEFLY”, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
